description: HTTP layer: all controllers, all routes, app.js, server.js, and README.md. Depends on all previous FEATs. Controllers are thin wrappers over services; routes wire validators + auth middleware + controllers. app.js assembles everything; server.js is the entry point.
steps: Create backend/src/controllers/auth.controller.js: require auth.service. register: call service.register(req.body), set httpOnly cookie 'refreshToken', return 201 {success:true,data:{user,accessToken}}. login: same pattern. logout: call service.logout(req.user._id), clear cookie, return 200. refreshToken: get token from req.cookies.refreshToken||req.body.refreshToken; call service.refreshTokens(token), set new cookie, return 200 {accessToken,refreshToken}. getMe: return 200 {success:true,data:{user:sanitizeUser(req.user)}}.

Create backend/src/controllers/user.controller.js: getAllUsers, getUserById, createUser, updateUser, deleteUser — each calls corresponding user.service method, wraps in try/catch passing to next(), returns appropriate status codes (200/201/204). getAllUsers passes req.query page/limit/sort/role/isActive as filters.

Create backend/src/controllers/lead.controller.js: getAllLeads, getLead, createLead, updateLead, deleteLead, updateLeadStatus, assignLead, convertLead — thin wrappers on lead.service, pass req.user as needed. createLead/updateLead pass req.user._id as createdBy/performedBy. convertLead calls service.convertLead, returns 200 {customer, deal}.
Create backend/src/controllers/customer.controller.js: getAllCustomers, getCustomer, createCustomer, updateCustomer, deleteCustomer — thin wrappers on customer.service.

Create backend/src/controllers/deal.controller.js: getAllDeals, getDeal, createDeal, updateDeal, deleteDeal, updateDealStage — thin wrappers. updateDealStage passes req.user._id as performedBy and req.user.role for transition permission check.

Create backend/src/controllers/activity.controller.js: getAllActivities, getActivity, createActivity, updateActivity, deleteActivity, completeActivity — thin wrappers. completeActivity passes req.user._id.

Create backend/src/controllers/timeline.controller.js: getLeadTimeline (entityType='lead', entityId=req.params.id), getCustomerTimeline (entityType='customer'), getDealTimeline (entityType='deal') — all call TimelineService.getTimeline, return paginated results.

Create backend/src/controllers/dashboard.controller.js: getStats, getPipeline, getTeamPerformance (pass req.query.startDate/endDate), getRecentActivities (pass req.query.limit) — call dashboard.service methods.

Create backend/src/routes/auth.routes.js: const router=express.Router(); POST /register validate(registerSchema) + authController.register; POST /login validate(loginSchema) + authController.login; POST /logout authenticate + authController.logout; POST /refresh-token authController.refreshToken; GET /me authenticate + authController.getMe. module.exports=router.

Create backend/src/routes/user.routes.js: all routes behind authenticate+authorize('admin'). GET / getAllUsers; POST / validate(createUserSchema) createUser; GET /:id getUserById; PUT /:id validate(updateUserSchema) updateUser; DELETE /:id deleteUser.

Create backend/src/routes/lead.routes.js: authenticate on all. GET / getAllLeads; POST / validate(createLeadSchema) createLead; GET /:id getLead; PUT /:id validate(updateLeadSchema) updateLead; DELETE /:id authorize('admin','sales_manager') deleteLead; PATCH /:id/status validate(z.object({status:...})) updateLeadStatus; PATCH /:id/assign authorize('admin','sales_manager') validate(assignLeadSchema) assignLead; POST /:id/convert authorize('admin','sales_manager') validate(convertLeadSchema) convertLead.
Create backend/src/routes/customer.routes.js: authenticate on all. Standard CRUD — GET / POST / GET /:id PUT /:id DELETE /:id — with appropriate validators and authorize for delete.
Create backend/src/routes/deal.routes.js: authenticate on all. Standard CRUD + PATCH /:id/stage validate(updateStageSchema) updateDealStage.
Create backend/src/routes/activity.routes.js: authenticate on all. Standard CRUD + PATCH /:id/complete completeActivity.
Create backend/src/routes/timeline.routes.js: authenticate on all. GET /lead/:id getLeadTimeline; GET /customer/:id getCustomerTimeline; GET /deal/:id getDealTimeline.

Create backend/src/routes/dashboard.routes.js: authenticate on all. GET /stats getStats; GET /pipeline getPipeline; GET /team-performance authorize('admin','sales_manager') getTeamPerformance; GET /recent-activities getRecentActivities.

Create backend/app.js: require('dotenv').config(); const express=require('express'); const helmet=require('helmet'); const cors=require('cors'); const morgan=require('morgan'); const cookieParser=require('cookie-parser'); const rateLimit=require('express-rate-limit'); const errorHandler=require('./src/middleware/errorHandler'); const AppError=require('./src/utils/AppError'); const app=express(); app.use(helmet()); app.use(cors({origin:process.env.ALLOWED_ORIGINS?.split(','),credentials:true})); app.use(morgan(process.env.NODE_ENV==='production'?'combined':'dev')); app.use(express.json({limit:'10kb'})); app.use(express.urlencoded({extended:true})); app.use(cookieParser()); const limiter=rateLimit({windowMs:15*60*1000,max:100,message:'Too many requests'}); app.use('/api',limiter); mount all 8 routers: app.use('/api/auth',authRoutes); app.use('/api/users',userRoutes); etc. app.all('*',(req,res,next)=>next(new AppError(`Route ${req.originalUrl} not found`,404))); app.use(errorHandler); module.exports=app.

Create backend/server.js: require('dotenv').config(); const app=require('./app'); const {connectDB}=require('./src/config/database'); const PORT=process.env.PORT||5000; const start=async()=>{ await connectDB(); const server=app.listen(PORT,()=>console.log(`Server running on port ${PORT} in ${process.env.NODE_ENV} mode`)); process.on('unhandledRejection',(err)=>{ console.error('Unhandled rejection:',err); server.close(()=>process.exit(1)); }); process.on('uncaughtException',(err)=>{ console.error('Uncaught exception:',err); process.exit(1); }); }; start();

Create backend/README.md: sections — Overview, Tech Stack, Prerequisites, Installation (git clone, cd backend, npm install, cp .env.example .env, fill in vars, npm run dev), Environment Variables table, API Endpoints reference table (all 40+ endpoints with method/path/auth/description), Role Permissions table (admin/sales_manager/sales_executive capabilities), Data Models brief description, Error Response format.
acceptance_criteria: All 8 controller files exist and export their handler functions
All 8 route files exist and export an Express Router
app.js applies helmet, cors, rate-limit, mounts all 8 route prefixes, and has global error handler last
POST /api/auth/register with missing email returns 400 with validation error
npm start exits cleanly on DB connection error (graceful error log, not crash without message)
README.md covers all environment variables and endpoints
verification: node -e "const app=require('./app'); console.log(typeof app)" — prints 'function' (Express app is a function)
node -e "const r=require('./src/routes/lead.routes'); console.log(r.stack.length)" — prints number > 5 (routes registered)
npm start 2>&1 | head -5 — shows server start attempt (will fail without DB but module loading should succeed)
findings: All 8 controllers and 8 route files created. app.js verified (typeof === 'function'). lead.routes stack=9, auth.routes stack=5. server.js wraps connectDB() with try/catch for graceful startup failure. README covers all env vars, 40+ endpoints, role permissions, data models, and error format.
